narrative.overview: Harmonic is a dense operator console in a matte, low-chroma Paper register. Teal speaks for the interface and tooling; indigo marks the single state that needs the operator. The Board is ordered by attention, with the review gate always clear and reachable.
keyCharacteristics: Teal action and tooling voice with indigo review voice
True light and dark themes with Soft and Bold densities
Semantic state color that never carries meaning alone

rules.name: Two Voices
rules.body: Teal means action, tooling, and ready. Indigo means review and needs-you. Neither decorates generic content.

rules.name: Mono Is Code
rules.body: Use monospace only for code identities such as paths, branch refs, commands, hashes, and session IDs.

rules.name: Review Gate
rules.body: Reject is ghost and Accept & merge is teal, last, and sticky on the current run.

dos: Do order the Board by what needs the operator now.
Do use teal for ordinary actions and indigo only for review.
Do use merged and merging in operator-facing copy.
donts: Don't use teal for review state.
Don't use monospace for ordinary prose or figures.
Don't reintroduce Deck row lists, connector lines, or a Kanban board.
